status: Winding Cliffs recording-ready; Lost Canyon and Marksman follow in the next batch

caleb.name: Caleb
caleb.role: Escaped prisoner who helps you follow the transport trail

skip.name: Skip
skip.role: Climber who trades a useful ridge route for his missing rope

hp.caleb.first.text: You're from Briar? I saw the smoke. I ran when the wagon lost a wheel. Ruth stayed with the others. I told myself I'd come back with help. You're the first person who hasn't told me to keep running.

choices.text: Then let's make the trip back count.

effects.title: The prisoner trail
effects.text: Caleb escaped from a broken wagon. Follow the wheel tracks past the split trail. Look for scraps of pale cloth.

voice.speaker: caleb
voice.scene: An escaped prisoner at the refuge
voice.emotion: Exhausted male voice. Shame under the relief, not helplessness.
voice.direction: Exhausted male voice. Shame under the relief, not helplessness.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. An escaped prisoner at the refuge

hp.caleb.blame.text: Yes. I did. You can spend the morning telling me that, or we can find the people still in chains. I can get you to the wagon. After that, I need someone who can fight.

choices.text: You're right. Show me the trail.

effects.title: The prisoner trail
effects.text: Follow the broken wagon tracks beyond the split trail. Pale cloth marks the bend.

voice.speaker: caleb
voice.emotion: Hurt, but firm. He will not let an argument cost the prisoners their chance.
voice.direction: Hurt, but firm. He will not let an argument cost the prisoners their chance.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. A blunt challenge

hp.caleb.trail.text: Take the lower path past the split rocks. The wagon is below the tall stone arch. I tied bits of my shirt along the trail. It was a good shirt. I'd like to call that a noble sacrifice, but the wheels had already ruined it.

choices.text: Can anyone down there help us?

voice.speaker: caleb
voice.emotion: Practical. A brief, tired smile at the shirt joke.
voice.direction: Practical. A brief, tired smile at the shirt joke.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. Directions without revealing every location

hp.caleb.timing.text: They wait at the canyon cages until the next escort arrives. The lookout controls the lift down. Lower the freight bridge first. You can fight through the lookout, or try the high shelves behind it. I wouldn't cross those shelves in a strong gust.

voice.speaker: caleb
voice.emotion: Measured urgency. Do not imply an invisible countdown has started.
voice.direction: Measured urgency. Do not imply an invisible countdown has started.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. Escort timing and two approaches

hp.caleb.ruth.text: Ruth kept us moving when the guards stopped feeding us. She counted everyone at every stop. Not numbers. Names. If she's still there, she'll know who needs help and which cages they moved.

voice.speaker: caleb
voice.emotion: Sincere respect, with a little strength returning.
voice.direction: Sincere respect, with a little strength returning.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. Why these prisoners matter

hp.caleb.keep.text: Ruined Keep. Then those cages are only a stop along the way. Get them out before the next escort leaves. I'll stay where anyone escaping can see me. This time, nobody has to make that walk alone.

voice.speaker: caleb
voice.scene: Evidence gives the journey its next destination
voice.emotion: Resolve replaces guilt. No knowledge of the hidden castle.
voice.direction: Resolve replaces guilt. No knowledge of the hidden castle.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. Evidence gives the journey its next destination

hp.skip.first.text: Mind the edge. It has a very strict no-refunds policy. Name's Skip. I climb these cliffs for a living, which sounded much better before I said it out loud.

choices.text: You look like you lost something.

effects.title: Skip’s rope
effects.text: Skip dropped his rope below the broken platform east of his rest spot. Bring it back to open his ridge route.

choices.text: Is there another way past the patrol?

voice.speaker: skip
voice.emotion: Light male voice. Dry, friendly humor; never mock the player.
voice.direction: Light male voice. Dry, friendly humor; never mock the player.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. Meeting the local climber

hp.skip.rope.text: My good rope is hanging below the broken platform east of here. There is a lower shelf you can reach without a long fall. Bring it back and I'll rig the ridge crossing. There's a spear in it for you, too. Long reach. Useful when something bites.

effects.title: Skip’s ridge is open
effects.text: Skip has rigged the high ridge beyond his rest spot. Short jumps lead to a hidden overlook. A broad lower shelf catches missed jumps.

choices.text: How should I cross the ridge?
Does the spear come with a no-falling promise?

voice.speaker: skip
voice.scene: A return quest with a useful reward
voice.emotion: Clear directions first; warm grin on the last sentence.
voice.direction: Clear directions first; warm grin on the last sentence.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. A return quest with a useful reward

hp.skip.joke.text: Absolutely. The spear has never fallen off a cliff. I have, twice. We agreed not to hold each other responsible.

voice.speaker: skip
voice.scene: A small joke, no extra branch burden
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. A small joke, no extra branch burden

hp.skip.advice.text: Watch the hanging cloth. When it drops, the wind is easing. You can tie the windbreak below this shelf shut to shelter the upper crossing. On the high ridge, take one landing at a time. That purple glint up there is real. I wasn't brave enough to check it.

voice.speaker: skip
voice.scene: Climbing advice, not an exact shard marker
voice.emotion: Confident about climbing; mildly embarrassed about the glint.
voice.direction: Confident about climbing; mildly embarrassed about the glint.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. Climbing advice, not an exact shard marker

hp.skip.thanks.text: That's the one. I've tied off the ridge crossing. And here's Cliff Runner, as promised. Try the long pointy end first. People keep inventing much worse ways to use it.

voice.speaker: skip
voice.scene: Quest turned in; ridge and fixed javelin reward
voice.emotion: Genuine gratitude with an easy laugh.
voice.direction: Genuine gratitude with an easy laugh.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. Quest turned in; ridge and fixed javelin reward

hp.skip.ready.text: The ridge is yours. If you're heading for the prisoners, the freight bridge is below us. Match its hanging weights to the marks on the plate, then use the brake attached to the bridge. The other brake holds the cart. Ask me how I learned that.

voice.speaker: skip
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. Post-quest practical guidance

hp.skip.brake.text: A very short ride. A very long walk back.

voice.speaker: skip
voice.scene: A quick button on the joke
voice.emotion: Brief deadpan. Let the pause do the work.
voice.direction: Brief deadpan. Let the pause do the work.
voice.context: Winding Cliffs. Prisoners are being taken to Ruined Keep. The player is a brave local, not a known Bladeborn. A quick button on the joke

effects.title: Prisoner transport orders
effects.text: The prisoners are bound for Ruined Keep. First reach the Lost Canyon holding yard. The freight bridge leads to the lookout and its lift.

effects.title: Rope found
effects.text: Bring the rope back to Skip at the high rest spot.

effects.title: Freight bridge
effects.text: The plate has seven marks. Three hanging weights show two, three and five marks. The bridge brake has a cable running to the bridge; the cart brake holds the wagon.

effects.title: The wrong brake
effects.text: The cart rolled against its stop, and the weights dropped back. Nobody was hurt. Use the brake connected to the bridge.

effects.title: Bridge lowered
effects.text: The freight bridge is down. The lower path leads through the patrol. The high shelves reach a rope behind the lookout.

effects.title: Behind the lookout
effects.text: You tied a rope behind the lookout. You can reach the lift without fighting through the lower patrol.

effects.title: The way down
effects.text: The lift into Lost Canyon is ready. Find Ruth and stop the next prisoner transport.

effects.title: The cliff chest
effects.text: Three groups of marked supports sit along this side trail. Count the marked supports beneath one dot, then two dots, then three dots. Press those three numbers on the chest lock. A wrong number starts it over.

effects.title: The windbreak is tied shut
effects.text: The cloth screens now shelter the exposed upper crossing. The lower trail remains safe too.
